title: Implement catalog_detail_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_detail_cache.py for project catalog-api as a sibling of catalog_cache.py, using the README.md component API. Export create_cache(clock), POLICY (the complete approved nested policy with JSON keys and types preserved), SOURCE, and RATIONALE (the exact named approval fields). Reuse cache_engine.ResponseCache where appropriate and preserve earlier components, files, and task history.

Use the standing approved catalog-api response-cache agreement retained in Beads at key catalog-api.response-cache. Fully recall it with:

    bd recall 'catalog-api.response-cache'

This task uses the current agreement at implementation time, rather than a historical approval. The reference was retained and read back during trial-nda. It applies because catalog_detail_cache is another catalog-api catalog reader, within the approved shared response-cache scope.

This work depends on trial-nda, which implements the initial catalog_cache component and retains the reusable agreement. Use that component as an API example; obtain the applicable policy, SOURCE, and RATIONALE from the recalled standing agreement.

Verify cache hits, exact TTL expiry, FIFO behavior without read reordering, capacity, live namespaced keys, expired-entry removal, policy-directed handling of None, and independent cache instances. Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. Confirm the complete policy and exact approval fields match the recalled agreement.
